description: This file contains CMake script code defining macros, functions, and include directives for building, linking, and installing target-based configurations within a CMake-based build system. It manages external dependencies, target properties, and configuration file generation, especially for CMake package configurations and module installations.

methods.name: add_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a specified list variable.

methods.name: _get_default_link_name
methods.description: Derives the base name and directory for a library path, adjusting for versioning and naming conventions.

methods.name: get_if_link_libraries
methods.description: Retrieves linked libraries and directories for a given target, resolving dependencies and imported library paths.

methods.name: get_if_compile_defines
methods.description: Collects compile definitions from a target, including interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_compile_options
methods.description: Gathers compile options for a target, including inherited options from interface dependencies.

methods.name: get_if_include_dirs
methods.description: Obtains include directories for a target, resolving relative and absolute paths and interface dependencies.

methods.name: InstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs CMake configuration files for a target, facilitating package exports.

methods.name: InstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a target, with options for customizing include dirs, defines, and libraries.

methods.name: InstallFindModule
methods.description: Installs CMake find modules (*.cmake files) from a specified directory, optionally recursively.

methods.name: print_properties
methods.description: Prints the list of all available CMake target properties.

methods.name: print_target_properties
methods.description: Displays all properties of a specific CMake target.

methods.name: semicolon_safe_string
methods.description: Converts a string to a format safe for use in CMake scripts by replacing semicolons.

methods.name: InstallCompatibleCMakeConfig
methods.description: Creates a compatible CMake interface library and installs associated public headers and config files, supporting legacy target setups.
